inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: During the inspection it was found that the operation is not maintaining current feeding instructions for the infant classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver in the infant classroom did not have an background check.      Corrected:  Caregiver left for the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A two  month old infant was sleeping in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: One child did not have information that parents received the operational polices.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: They was one caregiver with 10 children specified age group 18-23 months old, they were one over ratio.       Corrected:  When another caregiver join the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: One caregiver stated they had 9 children in care and when I counted they were only 7 children. Another caregiver stated they were responsible for 4 children and they was 15 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Five caregivers did not have all they annual training for they training year. One caregiver had 22 hours for training year 8/17/22 to 8/17/23, one caregiver had 11 hours of training for training year 3/23/22 to 3/23/23, one caregiver had 16 hours of training for training year 2/21/22 to 2/21/23, one caregiver had 22 hours for training year 4/9/22 to 4/9/23, and the last caregiver had 15 hours of training for training year 3/28/22 to 3/28/23.     Corrected:  I took hours for current training year: 8/17/23 to 8/17/24 2 hours. 3/23/23 to 3/23/34 17 hours, 2/21/23 to2/21/24 8 hours, 4/9/23 to 4/9/23 2 hours and 3/28/23 to 3/28/24 8 hours of training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One child was missing the helathcare information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child is missing a health care statement, the child has been enrolled since 11/1/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One child was missing the address for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: One child's file had documentation they had a allergy to fish and eggs and did not have a allergy plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening: Two children that are four years old did not have a hearing and vision test on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One caregiver did not have a school diploma.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The operation did not have documentation for their fire inspection report for the 836 location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The operation did not document the time of their fire, shelter, severe weather and lock down drills.       Corrected:  When I reviewed the standard with the operation and in future drills the time will be documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children did not was their hands before eating snack.       Corrected:  When children wash their hands before eating lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The operations sign in/out sheets did not have initials of employees or parents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours: The director was missing four hours of training for training year 1/1/2022 to 1/1/2023.      Corrected:  When the four hours were taken from training year 1/1/2023 to 1/1/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The operation did not have the updated inspection report posted, the inspection report posted was 7/25/2022 and the last inspection was on April 18, 2023.       Corrected:  When the operation posted the most recent inspection form that was conducted on 4/18/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Vision and Hearing Screening (26 TAC §746.603(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation did not have in their emergency preparedness plan on how they would evacuating and relocating children who are under 24 months of age or children with limited mobility. The emergency preparedness plan was also missing how caregivers would keep an attendance of children who have evacuated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered: When given medication to children they was not a employees full name that administered  medication.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Employee Who Administered (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have an updated fire inspection, the last fire inspection was conducted on 5/25/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Two changing mats the one in the indoor play area and the other on the outside restroom area had rips in them.       Corrected:  When the operation replace the old mats with new ones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: In the indoor gym area and one of the toddler classrooms did not have an emergency evacuation and relocation diagram posted in the rooms.      Corrected:  When the operation posted the emergency evacuation and relocation diagrams.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The operations sign in/out sheets did not have intials of employees or parents.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Two caregivers is missing annual training on is missing 19 hours the other is missing 6 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
